Horsehead Corporation, headquartered at 300 Frankfort Road in Monaca, Pennsylvania, stands as a significant player in the American metals and chemicals industry. The company has built its reputation as one of North America's largest recyclers and producers of zinc and zinc-based products, playing a crucial role in the circular economy by transforming industrial waste into valuable resources.

Founded on principles of environmental stewardship and industrial innovation, Horsehead Corporation specializes in recovering zinc from electric arc furnace (EAF) dust, a byproduct of steel manufacturing that would otherwise be classified as hazardous waste. Through their proprietary recycling processes, the company converts this waste material into high-quality zinc oxide, zinc metal, and other zinc-based products that serve diverse industries including rubber, chemicals, ceramics, agriculture, and pharmaceuticals.

The Monaca facility represents just one part of Horsehead's operational footprint, which has historically included multiple processing plants strategically located across the United States. The company's commitment to sustainable manufacturing practices has positioned them as an essential link in the steel industry's supply chain, helping steel producers meet environmental regulations while recovering valuable materials. Their innovative approach to metallurgical processing demonstrates how industrial operations can balance economic viability with environmental responsibility, creating value from materials that would otherwise pose disposal challenges.
